description: V1 owned context plane — gateway + workspace/memory/export ports, replaceable AgentRuntime (TrueForge below the line), self-host product with private enterprise adapters out of tree.

userStories.title: Formalize sovereignty ports and stub adapters
userStories.description: As an operator integrating Apostle, I want stable port interfaces (Identity, Entitlements, Gateway, Provider, Context, Workspace, Memory, Corpus, AgentRuntime, Skills, Export, Safety, Theme) with OSS stub defaults so enterprise adapters can plug in privately without forking core.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/apostle/ports/ exports typed interfaces for all 13 ports listed in docs/v1-roadmap.md
createDefaultPorts() returns stub implementations that are safe no-ops or thin wrappers over existing gateway helpers where applicable
docs/ports.md documents each port, ownership boundary, and TrueForge placement
docs/ports.md states customer brand/SSO/corpus adapters must not be committed to this repo
node test for ports registry passes
Typecheck passes
No customer brand names (e.g. social platforms or holding-company product lines) appear in committed OSS docs or source for this story
userStories.notes: Do not wire TrueForge network client yet — stub AgentRuntime only. Keep private customer naming out of git.

userStories.title: Workspace projects schema and store
userStories.description: As a user, I want projects that contain threads, files, and a prompt library so my AI life is organized above the model line.
acceptanceCriteria: DB migration adds projects, project_files, prompt_library tables (or equivalent) linked to user
WorkspaceStore port has a real Postgres/PGLite-backed implementation for list/create project and attach thread to project
Existing threads remain usable (default project or null project_id with backfill)
Typecheck and relevant tests pass
No private customer brand names in committed source or docs

userStories.title: Portable memory CRUD + panel shell
userStories.description: As a user, I want visible editable global and project memory that travels across model switches.
acceptanceCriteria: MemoryPort backed by DB with scope global|project
Chat or Desk UI shows Memory panel list with edit/delete
ContextAssembler stub reads memory items when assembling (even if not yet injected into live chat)
Typecheck and tests pass
No private customer brand names in committed source or docs

userStories.title: Model switcher attribution and floor failover
userStories.description: As a user, I want to switch models mid-thread and see which model answered, with failover to a floor adapter when providers fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages store model id attribution
UI model picker changes thread default without losing history
GatewayPort resolve path supports failover chain ending at floor/local adapter
Failover surfaces a plain notice string for the client
Typecheck and tests pass
No private customer brand names in committed source or docs

userStories.title: Export schema v1 and Vault endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want one-click export of projects, threads, files, memory, prompts, and skills in an open schema.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/export-schema-v1.md published
ExportPort builds zip or JSON archive for the current user
Desk or settings Vault entry triggers export download
